name: Niedersachsen Richtlinie Erhalt und Entwicklung der Biologischen Vielfalt (BiolV)

summary: State biodiversity grants for Lower Saxony and Bremen funding restoration and management of valuable habitats (bogs and fens, waters and floodplains, heaths, species-rich grassland), species recovery and reintroduction, land purchase for conservation, conservation machinery, and Natura 2000 management plans.
